title: Cornering MeV-GeV Axions and Dark Photons with LDMX
summary: Axion-like particles (ALPs), the QCD axion, and dark photons in the MeV-GeV mass range are motivated by various dark matter models and the strong CP problem, and are ubiquitous in extensions of the Standard Model. A long-standing blind spot for experimental searches is the sub-100 MeV mass range, where the particle lifetime is too long to be constrained by prompt-decay collider searches yet too short to be reached by beam-dump experiments.
